map.轨道半径 r=6.77×10⁶ m（约 400 km 高度）、地球 μ=3.98: Orbital radius r=6.77×10⁶ m (about 400 km altitude) and Earth μ=3.986×10¹⁴. T=2pi√((6.77e6)³/3.986e14)=2pi√(3.10e20/3.986e14)=2pi√(7.78e5)≈2pi×882≈5540 s≈92.3 min. That is, about one orbit of the Earth every 92 minutes.
map.轨道越高周期越长还是越短？: Is the period longer or shorter at higher orbit?
map.越长。由开普勒第三定律 T∝r^(3/2)，高度翻倍周期显著增大；地球同步轨道: Longer. By Kepler's third law T is proportional to r^(3/2), so doubling the altitude markedly increases the period; geosynchronous orbit r≈4.2×10⁷ m has a period ≈24 h, synchronous with the rotation of the Earth.
map.椭圆轨道周期怎么算？: How is an elliptical orbit period calculated?
map.用半长轴 a 替代 r（T=2π√(a³/μ)），与形状无关只与半长轴有关。本工: Use the semi-major axis a in place of r (T=2pi√(a³/μ)); it is independent of the shape and depends only on the semi-major axis. This tool computes with the circular orbital radius r; for an ellipse substitute the semi-major axis.
